__inputs.label: Prometheus

title: Tyk MDCB
description: Tyk MDCB control plane: connected data planes, dependencies, RPC, config sync, analytics, certificates and runtime.

panels.title: Environment
panels.description: Deployment environment this MDCB runs in. Metric: tyk.mdcb.build.info

panels.title: Control plane
panels.description: Control plane ID this MDCB serves. Metric: tyk.mdcb.build.info

panels.title: MDCB version
panels.description: MDCB version running on the replicas. Metric: tyk.mdcb.build.info

panels.title: MDCB replicas
panels.description: MDCB replicas currently reporting. Metric: tyk.mdcb.build.info

panels.title: Gateways connected to MDCB
panels.description: Gateways connected to MDCB right now. Metric: tyk.mdcb.gateway.connected

panels.title: Dependency health
panels.description: Whether MDCB could reach its datastore and Redis (Connected) and whether its RPC server passed its check (Passing), worst result across replicas. Metric: tyk.mdcb.health

panels.title: License expires in
panels.description: Days left on the MDCB license. MDCB stops when it expires. Metric: tyk.mdcb.license.expiry_timestamp

targets.expr: label_replace((min((tyk_mdcb_license_expiry_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"} - time()) / 86400)) < 14, "state", "✕ Under 14 days", "", "") or label_replace((min((tyk_mdcb_license_expiry_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"} - time()) / 86400)) >= 14 < 30, "state", "⚠ Under 30 days", "", "") or label_replace((min((tyk_mdcb_license_expiry_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id"} - time()) / 86400)) >= 30, "state", "✓ Over 30 days", "", "")

panels.title: RPC certificate expires in
panels.description: Days left on the TLS certificate gateways use to connect to MDCB. Metric: tyk.mdcb.cert.expiry_timestamp

targets.expr: label_replace((min((tyk_mdcb_cert_expiry_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",cert_type="rpc_tls"} - time()) / 86400)) < 14, "state", "✕ Under 14 days", "", "") or label_replace((min((tyk_mdcb_cert_expiry_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",cert_type="rpc_tls"} - time()) / 86400)) >= 14 < 30, "state", "⚠ Under 30 days", "", "") or label_replace((min((tyk_mdcb_cert_expiry_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",cert_type="rpc_tls"} - time()) / 86400)) >= 30, "state", "✓ Over 30 days", "", "")

panels.title: MDCB uptime
panels.description: Time since the most recently started MDCB replica came up. Metric: process.uptime

panels.title: Telemetry export
panels.description: Whether MDCB's last metrics export succeeded. Metric: tyk.mdcb.telemetry.exporter.healthy

panels.title: Data planes by group
panels.description: Gateway groups connected to this control plane, with gateway count, change over the last hour, oldest heartbeat and loaded APIs and policies. Metrics: tyk.mdcb.gateway.connected, tyk.mdcb.gateway.last_heartbeat_timestamp, tyk.mdcb.gateway.apis_loaded, tyk.mdcb.gateway.policies_loaded

targets.expr: (count by (group_id) (count by (group_id, gateway_id) (tyk_mdcb_gateway_connected{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"})) or 0 * count by (group_id) (count by (group_id, gateway_id) (tyk_mdcb_gateway_connected{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"} offset 1h))) - (count by (group_id) (count by (group_id, gateway_id) (tyk_mdcb_gateway_connected{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"} offset 1h)) or 0 * count by (group_id) (count by (group_id, gateway_id) (tyk_mdcb_gateway_connected{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"})))

0 * (label_replace((time() - min by (group_id) (max by (group_id, gateway_id) (tyk_mdcb_gateway_last_heartbeat_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"}))) < 30, "state", "✓ Under 30s ago", "", "") or label_replace((time() - min by (group_id) (max by (group_id, gateway_id) (tyk_mdcb_gateway_last_heartbeat_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"}))) >= 30 < 90, "state", "⚠ 30 to 90s ago", "", "") or label_replace((time() - min by (group_id) (max by (group_id, gateway_id) (tyk_mdcb_gateway_last_heartbeat_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"}))) >= 90, "state", "✕ Over 90s ago", "", ""))

panels.title: Gateways that went missing
panels.description: Gateways connected in the last hour that are no longer reporting. Metric: tyk.mdcb.gateway.connected

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (gateway_id, hostname, group_id) (max_over_time(tyk_mdcb_gateway_connected{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"}[1h])) unless on (gateway_id) max by (gateway_id) (tyk_mdcb_gateway_connected{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"}), "state", "⚠ Not reporting", "", "")

defaults.noValue: ✓ No gateways went missing in the last hour

value.title: Open ${__value.raw} in Tyk Gateway Fleet Health

panels.title: Gateways per MDCB replica
panels.description: How gateway connections are spread across MDCB replicas. Metric: tyk.mdcb.gateway.connected

panels.title: Connection failures
panels.description: Failed gateway connection attempts per minute, by cause, against the same hour yesterday. Metric: tyk.mdcb.gateway.connect_errors

panels.title: Gateway reconnects
panels.description: Gateway reconnects per minute, against the same hour yesterday. A sharp rise across many gateways is a reconnect storm. Metric: tyk.mdcb.gateway.reconnects

panels.title: Gateway heartbeats and loaded config
panels.description: Connected gateways with their last heartbeat and how many APIs and policies each has loaded. Metrics: tyk.mdcb.gateway.connected, tyk.mdcb.gateway.last_heartbeat_timestamp, tyk.mdcb.gateway.apis_loaded, tyk.mdcb.gateway.policies_loaded

targets.expr: max by (gateway_id, hostname, group_id, version, segmented) (tyk_mdcb_gateway_connected{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"})

0 * (label_replace((time() - max by (gateway_id) (tyk_mdcb_gateway_last_heartbeat_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"})) < 30, "state", "✓ Under 30s ago", "", "") or label_replace((time() - max by (gateway_id) (tyk_mdcb_gateway_last_heartbeat_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"})) >= 30 < 90, "state", "⚠ 30 to 90s ago", "", "") or label_replace((time() - max by (gateway_id) (tyk_mdcb_gateway_last_heartbeat_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"})) >= 90, "state", "✕ Over 90s ago", "", ""))

panels.title: Gateways by version
panels.description: Connected gateways by Tyk Gateway version. Metric: tyk.mdcb.gateway.connected

panels.title: Dependency health

panels.title: Pool saturation
panels.description: Connections in use as a share of pool size. Above 80% the pool is close to full. Metrics: tyk.mdcb.connection_pool.active, tyk.mdcb.connection_pool.max

panels.title: Rejected connections
panels.description: Gateway connections refused per minute because the RPC server reached its connection limit. Metric: tyk.mdcb.connection_pool.rejected

panels.description: Connections in use (solid), idle (dotted) and pool size (dashed) per dependency. Metrics: tyk.mdcb.connection_pool.active, tyk.mdcb.connection_pool.idle, tyk.mdcb.connection_pool.max

panels.title: Idle connections
panels.description: Idle connections per dependency. Metric: tyk.mdcb.connection_pool.idle

panels.title: RPC requests by result
panels.description: RPC calls per second from gateways, by result. Metric: tyk.mdcb.rpc.requests

panels.title: RPC latency by method (p95)
panels.description: Response time of the slowest 5% of RPC calls, per method. CheckReload and CheckIdPReload are left out: gateways long-poll them and MDCB holds each call for about one second by design. Metric: tyk.mdcb.rpc.duration

panels.title: Top groups by RPC requests
panels.description: The 10 gateway groups sending the most RPC calls per second. Metric: tyk.mdcb.rpc.requests

panels.title: Top gateways by RPC requests
panels.description: The 10 gateways sending the most RPC calls per second. Metric: tyk.mdcb.rpc.requests

panels.title: RPC data transferred
panels.description: RPC payload bytes per second between MDCB and gateways, by direction. Metric: tyk.mdcb.rpc.bytes

panels.title: Last successful sync
panels.description: When each resource type last synced successfully for each group. MDCB syncs when a gateway connects (bulk push) or after a configuration change (pull), not on a timer, so an old time on a stable estate is normal: use Sync failures by cause to spot problems. Metric: tyk.mdcb.sync.last_success_timestamp

targets.expr: 0 * (label_replace((time() - max by (group_id, resource_type, mode) (tyk_mdcb_sync_last_success_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"})) < 300, "state", "Under 5 min ago", "", "") or label_replace((time() - max by (group_id, resource_type, mode) (tyk_mdcb_sync_last_success_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"})) >= 300 < 900, "state", "5 to 15 min ago", "", "") or label_replace((time() - max by (group_id, resource_type, mode) (tyk_mdcb_sync_last_success_timestamp{service_name="tyk-mdcb",control_plane_id=~"$control_plane_id",deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment",service_instance_id=~"$service_instance_id",group_id=~"$group_id"})) >= 900, "state", "Over 15 min ago", "", ""))

panels.title: Running versions
panels.description: MDCB and Go versions running, with replica count. Metric: tyk.mdcb.build.info

panels.title: Uptime per replica
panels.description: Time since each MDCB replica started. A drop to near 0 is a restart. Metric: process.uptime

panels.title: Telemetry export per replica
panels.description: Whether each replica's last metrics export succeeded. Metric: tyk.mdcb.telemetry.exporter.healthy

panels.title: Memory in use, limit and next GC target
panels.description: Memory in use (solid) per replica, next GC target (dotted) and Go memory limit (dashed). Metrics: go.memory.used, go.memory.limit, go.memory.gc.goal

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Live goroutines per replica. A steady climb points to a leak. Metric: go.goroutine.count

panels.title: Allocation rate
panels.description: Heap bytes allocated per second (left axis) and allocations per second (right axis). Metrics: go.memory.allocated, go.memory.allocations

panels.title: CPU cores available
panels.description: CPU cores the Go scheduler can use (GOMAXPROCS). Metric: go.processor.limit

panels.title: GC target percent (GOGC)
panels.description: Configured GOGC value. Metric: go.config.gogc
